# LIBERO / LIBERO-Plus Assets

Set `PIVOT_Q_ROOT` and prepare the [official repositories](README.md#sibling-repositories).

The LIBERO checkout includes its assets. Download `assets.zip` separately for LIBERO-Plus.
For download, extraction, and directory checks, see
[LIBERO-Plus benchmark assets](README.md#libero-plus-benchmark-assets).

Extract assets into `$PIVOT_Q_ROOT/third_party/LIBERO-plus/libero/libero/assets/`,
with `new_objects/`, `textures/`, and `scenes/` directly inside that directory.
Remove any extra parent-directory nesting introduced by the archive.
Keep BDDL files and init_states, which define tasks and initial conditions.
